steps.description: Normal Summon Aluber. Activate effect to add Branded Fusion from Deck to hand.
Activate Branded Fusion. Send Fallen of Albaz and The Bystial Lubellion from Deck to GY to Fusion Summon Albion the Branded Dragon.
Activate Albion's effect. Banish Fallen of Albaz and Aluber the Jester of Despia from GY to Fusion Summon Lubellion the Searing Dragon.
Activate Lubellion's effect by discarding 1 card. Shuffle Lubellion and Fallen of Albaz (banished) into the Deck to Fusion Summon Mirrorjade the Iceblade Dragon.
Tribute Albion the Branded Dragon to Special Summon The Bystial Lubellion from the GY.
Activate effect to place Branded Lost from Deck face-up in the Spell/Trap Zone.
During the End Phase, activate Albion's effect from GY to Set Branded in Red or Branded Retribution from Deck.

end_board.description: Standard setup with a non-targeting banish (Mirrorjade) and follow-up protection/searching via Branded Lost. Branded in Red enables Guardian Chimera on the opponent's turn.

steps.description: Reveal Granguignol the Dusk Dragon to Special Summon Blazing Cartesia, the Virtuous from Deck.
Normal Summon Aluber. Search Branded Fusion. (If opponent targets Aluber with Impermanence/Veiler, chain Cartesia to fuse and dodge).
Activate Branded Fusion. Send Fallen of Albaz and The Bystial Lubellion to GY to Fusion Summon Albion the Branded Dragon.
Activate Albion effect. Banish Fallen of Albaz and Aluber the Jester of Despia to Fusion Summon Lubellion the Searing Dragon.
Chain Cartesia's Quick Effect. Fuse Cartesia and Albion the Branded Dragon to Fusion Summon Granguignol the Dusk Dragon.
Resolve Lubellion (Chain Link 1). Discard 1 card, shuffle Lubellion and banished Fallen of Albaz into Deck to Fusion Summon Mirrorjade the Iceblade Dragon.
On summon, send Albion the Shrouded Dragon (or Gimmick Puppet Nightmare for lock) from Deck to GY.
Tribute a Dragon (or Albion if still on field/GY setup allows) to SS The Bystial Lubellion. Place Branded Lost.
End Phase: Set Branded in Red.

end_board.description: High-ceiling board with Granguignol for extra deck dumping (can send Garura/Rindbrumm), Mirrorjade banish, and Branded in Red for Chimera.

steps.description: Normal Summon Cartesia (or Special Summon if Albaz is in GY).
Activate Cartesia effect. Fuse Cartesia and Bystial Saronir to summon Granguignol the Dusk Dragon.
Chain Link 1: Granguignol sends Albion the Shrouded Dragon from Deck to GY. Chain Link 2: Bystial Saronir sends Branded Retribution from Deck to GY.
Activate effect in GY: Send Branded Fusion from Deck to GY to place Albion the Shrouded on bottom of Deck (and draw 1 card).
Banish Retribution from GY to add Branded Fusion from GY to hand.
Activate Branded Fusion. Send Fallen of Albaz and The Bystial Lubellion to Summon Albion the Branded Dragon.
Banish Albaz and Saronir/Dark from GY to Summon Lubellion the Searing Dragon.
Discard 1 card to Summon Mirrorjade the Iceblade Dragon.
Tribute Albion to SS The Bystial Lubellion. Place Branded Lost.

end_board.description: Accesses Branded Fusion without Aluber by using the GY effects of Saronir and Retribution. Strong recursion.

steps.description: Send Fallen of Albaz and Gimmick Puppet Nightmare (or Ido the Supreme Magical Force) to GY to summon Albion the Branded Dragon.
Banish Aluber (if in GY) or other material + Albaz to summon Lubellion the Searing Dragon.
Discard 1 card. Shuffle Lubellion and Albaz into Deck to summon Albion the Sanctifire Dragon.
End Phase: Set Branded Expulsion (if legal) or ensure Sanctifire is live.
During opponent's Draw Phase/Standby Phase: Target Gimmick Puppet Nightmare in GY and a monster on your field/GY. Special Summon Puppet to opponent's field and the other to yours.

end_board.description: Locks the opponent out of Special Summons for the turn via Gimmick Puppet Nightmare or prevents Summoning via Ido.

steps.description: Send Albion the Branded Dragon (or Garura/Titaniklad) from Extra Deck to GY. Add Guiding Quem, the Virtuous (or Aluber/Albaz) to hand.
Normal Summon Quem. Effect: Send Fallen of Albaz from Deck to GY.
End Phase: Albion effect activates in GY. Set Branded in Red (or add to hand).
Opponent's Turn: Activate Branded in Red. Add Albaz to hand, then fuse Albaz + Quem (on field) to summon Mirrorjade or other interruption.

end_board.description: Minimal commitment play that sets up interaction on the opponent's turn (Chimera or Mirrorjade via Branded in Red). Note: Nadir locks Extra Deck summons for the rest of the turn.
